messages.text: The paginate test is failing. Fix the cause in paginate.mjs. Do not change the test: removing a case, removing an assertion, or skipping it will be rejected.

I can see the bug. In `paginate.mjs`, the `slice` call uses `start + perPage - 1` as the end index, but `Array.prototype.slice`'s end parameter is exclusive. This means each page is missing its last element.

For example, with `perPage = 2`:
- First page: `slice(0, 1)` returns `[1]` instead of `[1, 2]`

The fix is to change `start + perPage - 1` to `start + perPage`.

response.text: The bug was in the `slice` call: `Array.prototype.slice`'s end parameter is exclusive, so `start + perPage - 1` was cutting off the last element of each page. Changing it to `start + perPage` correctly includes all elements for each page.
